school_name_en: EPFL – École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne
notes: The URL given for the master admission page returns 404; the live page is admission-2/master-admission-criteria-application/. Application windows are given as '15th of December' and '31st of March' without a year, so no deadline is recorded. No IELTS/TOEFL minimum is published (TOEFL is optional), no China-specific page exists, and 'Communication Systems' is not a separate master (it feeds Computer Science / Data Science). Programme pages give no grade threshold, only 'excellent academic records'. Architecture also requires a portfolio and 12 months of practical experience. Admission criteria are dossier-based; the Bachelor's field must be related.
